Designated allied Sinner enters into overtime state, significantly boosting Attack, Attack Speed, and CRIT Rate for 15 seconds. After 15 seconds, they enter into a state of post-overtime fatigue, reducing Attack, Attack Speed, and CRIT Rate for 15 seconds.
Enters the field with full ultimate energy.
